_readme: Queue for the weekly article automation (see .claude/scheduled-tasks or ask Claude about the 'weekly-article' scheduled task). Each run takes the first entry with status 'pending' from the next category in rotation order, researches it, drafts an article, and marks it 'published' with the resulting slug + date. Category rotation order: immigration-law -> criminal-law -> conveyancing -> repeat. When fewer than 3 pending topics remain in any category, the task should flag it in its completion summary so more can be queued.
